_comment: TAP-6 method-audit grep baseline. Every entry is a KNOWN, register-tracked hit — i.e. a location the 2026-07-10 audit already found and filed as an OPEN register row (MARSYS_DEFECT_GAP_REGISTER_v2_0.md §11.1). tap6_method_grep.ts treats any grep hit matching (pattern, file, line_hash) here as QUARANTINED (expected, tracked, not a new failure). Any grep hit whose exact matched line is NOT in this baseline — whether a brand-new file or a second, unrelated occurrence in an already-baselined file — is a NEW violation and fails CI (Ring-2 fix, post-bacade1c: file-level keying was too coarse to catch a second unrelated occurrence in an already-baselined file). When a Phase-1 lane fixes an M-row, delete its baseline entries here so the grep starts enforcing the fix (ratchet). Regenerated 2026-07-10 by walking the live tree and hashing every matched line.

Kept baselined only because the grep's assign-or-colon regex pattern-matches the comparison syntax; left in place as a documented false-positive rather than reworded to dodge the grep (the code is correct as written).

NOT A VIOLATION (confirmed R6-1f): line ~144 is `SELECT count(*) ... WHERE verification_pass_status = 'two_pass_verified'` — a read-only SQL aggregation counting real, already-persisted row statuses for a quality metric (two_pass_verified_pct). Not a fabricated stamp. Kept baselined only because the grep's assign-or-colon regex pattern-matches the SQL comparison syntax; left in place as a documented false-positive.

NOT A VIOLATION (MC-029 / Śodhana Builder T6, YOGI-BINDU): `yogi_status = "two_pass_verified" if yogi_ok else "divergent_flagged"` — yogi_ok is the real boolean result of _yogi_point_two_pass()'s independent plain-degree-vs-integer-arcsecond cross-check (agrees iff divergence <=1 arcsec, a rounding-only tolerance). The literal is the display label for a genuinely computed verifier outcome, not a fabricated stamp — same disposition as the bo_laksana.py/bo_pramana_mapa.py entries above (comparison/branch syntax the grep's regex necessarily also matches).

SURFACED by the 2026-08-01 TAP-6 detector widening (positional/return forms were previously invisible). This hash covers 7 site(s): :675, :691, :707, :726, :738, :804, :2025. THIS IS the emitted value: ga_dashas_writer.py:3047-3048 assigns the _verify_<system>() return to every row of that system. EARNED-BY-RAISE for yogini/ashtottari/chara/naisargika/mudda/narayana — each enclosing _verify_* raises ValueError on disagreement, so reaching the return means a check that could have failed did not. NOT uniformly earned: the same hash covers _verify_vimshottari (:675), whose Pass 2 (FORENSIC birth-period lord) is wrapped in `if chart_id == CANONICAL_CHART_ID` — the NATIVE chart earns the status and EVERY OTHER CHART DOES NOT, because Pass 1's tolerance comparison ends in a bare `pass` (no-op) and cannot fail. A per-chart split, not a uniform verdict. Read and verified 2026-08-01; NOT adjudicated as correct.
